purpose: Reviewable, generation-ready shop UI asset prompts. This version avoids baked text, avoids embedded icons inside holders, and splits compound UI into Photoshop/game-friendly pieces.

global_style.style: polished premium casual mobile game UI, underwater aquarium theme, glossy rounded panels, beveled edges, soft neon glow, dark navy and deep ocean blue base colors, subtle underwater light rays, bubbles, coral and seaweed accents, clean readable UI, production-ready asset
global_style.rendering: high-quality 2D game UI asset, crisp edges, soft gradients, subtle inner highlights, soft shadows, no rough sketch, no wireframe
global_style.background: transparent alpha background preferred. If the generator cannot produce true transparency, use only a solid flat magenta background #FF00FF for chroma key removal
global_style.isolation: single asset only, centered, separated, no other UI elements, generous padding around asset
global_style.text_rule: no baked text in generated raster assets; all labels, numbers, titles, prices, and button copy must be rendered by the game or added later in Photoshop
global_style.composition_rule: if an asset contains many sub-assets, generate only the main container in that prompt; icons, badges, text, button fills, and decorative objects must be generated as separate assets
global_style.output_rule: transparent PNG game asset with clean alpha around the asset, no mockup screen, no device frame, no watermark, no checkerboard background
global_style.chroma_key_safety_rule: no magenta, pink, or violet spill on asset edges. If a magenta fallback background is used, it must remain perfectly flat #FF00FF outside the asset only, with no glow, no shadow, no antialias haze, no particles, no lighting spill, and no semi-opaque magenta pixels
global_style.size_rule: use the exact canvas size requested in each asset prompt; v2.1 sizes are intentionally smaller than v2.0 for easier Photoshop cleanup and faster iteration

prompt_usage_note: Each asset prompt is now a top-level key. Generate one top-level asset key at a time. Do not batch multiple keys into one image.

shop_header_bar_holder.prompt: Create only the reusable header bar container for an aquarium mobile game shop. Use a 900x260 canvas. The container should be a wide premium rounded rectangle frame, not a pill, not a capsule, not stretched. Keep the main shape about 820px wide and 190px tall, centered, with moderate rounded corners around 24px radius. Deep ocean navy-blue interior panel, glossy beveled cyan-blue border, subtle inner highlights, soft underwater light rays from the top, small bubbles, faint fish silhouettes, and very subtle coral/seaweed decoration near the far left and far right edges only. Leave clean empty space for separate title text, currency chips, and icons. No text, no numbers, no store icon, no embedded icons, no buttons, no extra UI elements. Single isolated container asset only. Exact canvas size: 900x260. Chroma key safety: the outside of the frame must be flat pure magenta #FF00FF with no glow, no shadow, no antialias haze, no particles, and no lighting spill. All cyan glow and highlights must stay inside the frame or directly on the frame border, not outside on the magenta background. The asset edges must separate cleanly from the magenta key color for Photoshop cleanup. Negative constraints: no oval shape, no fully rounded capsule ends, no squashed or compressed look, no extreme border radius, no outer glow, no drop shadow, no magenta spill, no pink edge haze, no ornate clutter, no icon, no text.
